content: Yesu tai nimameyomeyo ꞌigieboboꞌanena
ꞌEnega muliyega Yesu ꞌiila limana anuwa tapwalolo ꞌenaya ga nada ꞌebweu tai nima meyomeyona ꞌilobena.
Ta Palisiyao Yesu silomataꞌiꞌisi, be ꞌeguma tai nina ꞌigieboboꞌane Sabate ꞌenaya maꞌetamo ꞌenega sida eꞌewa.
ꞌEnega Yesu tai nina ꞌieonena, “ꞌUtoolo be ꞌulagama,” ga tai nina ꞌitoolo ga ꞌilaga.
Ga Yesu ꞌinapwanao ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Gete ꞌigu enaida ꞌemiya: To guinuwa boboꞌana ꞌedaya? Sabate ꞌena talelema nai tagieꞌelouya? Taꞌetoseyana nai taloemwawasa?” Ga ꞌina ona nigeya sieꞌieꞌisa.
Ta Yesu ꞌidune masimasiyedi ma ina gamwasowala ta ma ina nuwamwau ꞌidi debapaꞌala manuna, ga tai nina ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Nimayo ꞌuyasitoto,” ga tai nimana ꞌiyasitotona ga ꞌiboboꞌana.
ꞌEnega Palisiyao ma idi gamwasowala siapwesa ga Elodi ꞌina bodao maꞌediyao siloiloina be mwaꞌadega Yesu sida loemwawasaꞌese.
Boda Galili leꞌawinaya
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌipilisinedi ga ma ina tononoyao sidolo Galili leꞌawinaya, ta pwalu sinabwana simuliyenama.
Boda nidi getedi Yesu alena sinononaya ta Galiliyega be Yudiaega be Yelusalemega be Idumea senanega be Yolidani mali senega ta ꞌaina ꞌasa nidi Taiya be Saidoni selabediyega siegogonama.
Ta Yesu toleꞌoasao ꞌigieboboꞌanedi, ꞌenega toleꞌoasao yaudi siegigigilama sabi gitoona, ꞌenega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌieonedi, “Waga manugu wameꞌe be ꞌabo tomota siegigigila wawasae yagegelu wagaya.”
Ta tomotai nidi ꞌediya yaluyaluwa biꞌi siluguya, ꞌeguma Yesu siꞌitai, sibeꞌu sanamwaꞌuta matanaya ta sibwaubwau, sigwae, “ꞌOyo Yaubada Natuna.”
Ta Yesu ꞌiloina paꞌaledi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wabwaubwau apwesa ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Yaubada Natuna.”
Yesu site tuwelo ꞌiesinuwedi
ꞌEnega muliyega ꞌoyaya ꞌituꞌe ga ꞌina tononoyao nidi ꞌiesinuwediya ga ꞌibwauyedi ga situꞌema ꞌenaya,
ga ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌOmi wate tuwelo yaesinuwemiya be ꞌomi maꞌegwao tamiyami be muliyega yaetunemi ꞌaina sena ꞌediya be wada loguguya
ta waiwaiyega yaluyaluwa biꞌi tomota ꞌediyega wada ula apwesedi.”
Ta ꞌadi esanao getedi: Saimoni (tauna wate ꞌieesena Pita);
ta wate Yemesa matasina Yoni, taudi Sebedi natunao, ta Yesu ꞌieesedi Bowanage (ta Bowanage ꞌana mwalatoi ꞌaene taudi ꞌatuwa wepalala nadigega);
ta wate Anidulu be, Pilipi be, Batolomiu be, Madiu be, Tomasi be, mali Yemesa tauna Alipio natuna be, Tadiasi be, mali Saimoni, tauna togewana ꞌebeloina manuna;
ta wate Yudasa Isikaliota, tauna maꞌetamo Yesu ꞌida sipupuye.
Yesu ta Bielisibubi
ꞌEnega muliyega Yesu ꞌiila ꞌina ꞌasaya, ta boda sinabwa wawasae siegogona ꞌenaya ga nigeya sawesawenaya Yesu ma ina tononoyao sieyawaiꞌata be siꞌaꞌa.
Ta ꞌina susuyao sinonona ꞌaene Yesu nigeya ꞌida eyawaiꞌata, ꞌenega sitauya sabi ꞌauꞌewenama, manuna sinuwena ꞌaene, “Niꞌatu ꞌikabaleya.”
Ta loina ꞌana toeꞌitao ꞌaidi niꞌatu Yelusalemega simwaꞌutama ga Yesu ꞌina paisewa sinabwana siꞌitenaya ga sigwae, “Tai gete ꞌietoguinuwa manuna Bielisibubi,
yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌidi ꞌinapwana ꞌina waiwaiyega yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌiula apwesedi.”
ꞌEnega Yesu tomota nidi ꞌibwauyedima ga onasemalimaliyega ꞌieꞌita ꞌediya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase manuna Seitani ꞌaene tauna ꞌana bodao ꞌediya ꞌida etalauwala?”
Ta wate ꞌigwae, “ꞌEguma ꞌebweu ꞌebeloina ꞌenaya tomotai siweweyala be taudimo silosalosaiya maꞌetamo ꞌebeloina nina ꞌineneneta be ꞌibebeꞌu.
Wate ꞌeguma susu ꞌebweuna ta siweweyala be taudimo silosalosaiya maꞌetamo sineneta be ꞌidi miya ꞌitoꞌumali.
Seitani wate nadigega, ꞌeguma ma gosenao taudimo silosaiya ꞌiabe ꞌina ꞌebeloina nina ꞌibebeꞌu be ꞌigugumwala.

“ꞌEbeꞌita gete tai waiwaina nadigega Seitani ꞌina anuwaya. Nigeya sawesawenaya ꞌebweu yaita ꞌilulugu be ꞌina gwegwe ꞌiloꞌewadi, ta esi ꞌeguma ꞌebweu tai balaeyega toewaiwai nina nimana be ꞌaena ꞌiyona nuganedi ta ꞌenega muliyega sawesawenaya ꞌilulugu ꞌina anuwaya be ꞌina gwegwe nidi ꞌiloꞌewadi.
ꞌEnega gete yaeona ꞌaiꞌailimi ꞌaene tomota ꞌidi loegesiyao be ꞌidi ona toꞌumalina maiboꞌana Yaubada ꞌida nuwataudi,
ta ꞌabo yaita Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiꞌawa toꞌumaliyei, geyaꞌabo saꞌi Yaubada ꞌinuwanuwatau, ta gete bubuna toꞌumalina nina ꞌenaya ꞌida miyaataya.”
Gete nadigega Yesu ꞌionaꞌesa manuna sionaona ꞌaene tauna ꞌina waiwai yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌenega.
Yesu sinana be tasinao ꞌenaya simai
ꞌEnega niꞌatu Yesu sinana ta tasinao simai ga ꞌatamanaya sitoolo, ta ꞌenega ona namo sietunena be ꞌaene Yesu ꞌida apwesama ꞌediya.
Ga tomota nidi Yesu selabenaya simiyatowa sieonena, “ꞌInapwana, sinayo be tasimwao waꞌita apwesa, ta nuwanuwadi ꞌoyo.”
Ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Yaita sinagu ta yaisigedi tasigwao?”
Ga taudi nidi selabenaya simiyami ꞌiduneyediya ta ꞌigwae, “Gete taudi sinagu be tasigwao.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaisigedi Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa simulimuliye taudi tasigwao be nuugwao be wate sinagwao.”

footnotes.text: Bielisibubi: Yaluyaluwa biꞌiyao ꞌidi ꞌinapwana, ꞌebe matauta ta toꞌumalina, tauna Seitani ꞌana tolema, nai Seitani tauna. Lowa me Ekiloni sibwagobwago ꞌenaya.
